description_for_human: Govern Copilot workflow proposals, risk review, approval, release, and audit evidence.
description_for_model: Use Signal Foundry to search approved Copilot capabilities, recommend role-relevant workflow ideas, create proposals, score risk, submit review, approve or reject proposals, release approved capabilities, generate release packets, generate capability maps, and list audit-safe MCP activity. Do not use it for employee monitoring or productivity scoring.
